basic_info.description: Great Buy at this new low price -- Excelsior District House + ADU(?).  Presently occupied independently by long term tenants.  The interesting building has 3-stories, and you can't see that from street level, however, there is a basement with 7+ feet height clearance -- see photos.      Many possibilities, and at this price, very doable. Large yard that also has a second APN 6091-010a, a 625 Square Foot parcel of land at the rear.     Convenient location; MUNI 1/2 block away; Mission Street and Geneva are close by too.
